verdict.reason: The live M1111Dr2 prefix confirms that D3 is the dominant single-sample decoder hotspot, but the sealed M722r2/M732 fair comparison already gives strong A1-OSG zero off-chip psum spill. Candidate-favorable D3 Acc16 LB-FUSE reduces D3 on-chip RMW only 10.4818%, creates 1.3428x destination groups, and is 2.0075% slower; across D0+D2+D3 it increases RMW 15.1894% and is 8.2738% slower. A three-line buffer therefore closes lifetime/capacity, not a new backing-traffic or speedup claim.
verdict.paper_position: negative decoder dataflow ablation or implementation-capacity note only

m1111dr2_live_prefix_scope.population: first complete interlaken_01_a sample only: rows D0-D3 at sequence_sample_id 0

fifth_row_observation.use: append-progress sanity only; excluded from D0-D3 ratio of sums

m1111dr2_live_prefix_scope.forbidden_inference: These first-four-row live-prefix ratios are diagnostic only. They are not upgraded to multi-sequence, completed-production, system, paper-speedup, or final-checkpoint claims.

m712_m718_strong_a1_and_pidp.interpretation: D3 has a real destination-owner opportunity because its 13 weight tiles fit 16 entries; full PIDP is killed because D0-D2 refill dominates. This does not admit selective-PIDP speedup or LB-FUSE.

storage_and_width_audit.formula: three rows times output width times output channels times accumulator bytes

D3_acc24_Cout48_two_pass.reason: Two channel passes preserve capacity but duplicate direct grouping/service and underuse the 96-lane issue fabric; this is a losing sensitivity, not the chosen design.

D3_acc16_full96.required_wording: Acc16 is only a complete selected-M705 local-INT8 trace observation; 98552 exceeds signed16, so it cannot be a universal or final-checkpoint width guarantee.

strong_a1_D3_acc24_spatial_stripe.conclusion: The fair Acc24 A1 baseline already fits by a legal finite-width spatial stripe; comparing LB-FUSE against an unstriped spilling A1 would be a weak-baseline error.

real_traffic_and_port_audit.first_principles: A line buffer is itself psum backing. It removes real backing traffic only if contributions are combined in a smaller register/frontier before a line-buffer write; merely replacing the address range with three rows retains one read and one write per update. Source-order direct combining loses A1-OSG cross-source destination packing; restoring that destination-keyed state approaches A1-OSG/PIDP.
real_traffic_and_port_audit.conclusion: D3 alone shows a modest on-chip-RMW decrease, but no true off-chip backing decrease and no cycle win. Across the intended decoder headline, real on-chip RMW increases. The 1RW port and dense commit taxes remain charged and do not rescue LB-FUSE.

existing_project_support.M522: exact K3/S2/P1/OP1 polyphase address mapper; standalone logic-cost support only
existing_project_support.M523: boundary-aware 4/6/9-tap descriptor bundling; descriptor-only VCS support, not direct C2 performance or psum residency

prior_and_object_difference.H67_object_delta: binary ATLIF descriptors, parity-asymmetric destination contributor sets, signed local-INT8/Acc24 arithmetic, K8/96-wide issue, and one shared 240-KiB limit
prior_and_object_difference.difference_from_PIDP: PIDP is destination-major and can retain one destination accumulator without materialized scatter psums, but changes weight order and thrashes D0-D2; LB-FUSE remains source-major to preserve weight reuse and therefore needs row/frontier psum state. Adding enough destination-keyed grouping to recover PIDP's benefit collapses toward the already-audited A1-OSG/PIDP tradeoff.
prior_and_object_difference.novelty_decision: The object delta is a legitimate mapping detail but, without a same-resource benefit, is insufficient for a DATE contribution. Do not claim invention of line buffering, polyphase decomposition, or Acc16.

one_day_cpu_successor_gate.allowed_structural_delta: A frontier-combine schedule that preserves A1-OSG destination packing/group count while proving fewer serialized 1RW psum transactions; no new matcher, no free destination cache, and no off-chip-spill baseline.
one_day_cpu_successor_gate.frozen_inputs: existing sealed M705/M712/M718/M722/M732 payload and ledgers only; no new GPU capture, runner, EDA, or live M1111Dr2 consumption
one_day_cpu_successor_gate.primary_baseline: M732 fair A1-OSG: same 96 lanes, K8, 240 KiB, Acc24, 1RW psum service, dense commit, and legal D3 Acc24 spatial stripe
one_day_cpu_successor_gate.primary_candidate_precision: Acc24; Acc16 and Cout48 are separately labeled sensitivities only
required_outputs: exact contributor and Acc24 output mismatch count equal zero
on-chip psum read bytes, write bytes, off-chip spill bytes, descriptor bytes, weight bytes, and dense commit bytes
serialized 1RW stalls, row/frontier capacity including macro rounding, stripe overlap, and every replayed source/weight access
separate selected-sequence rows without inferring population or system behavior
one_day_cpu_successor_gate.go_if: Under the primary Acc24 coordinate, D3 A1/candidate >=1.20; alternatively candidate cycles are within 5% of A1 and on-chip psum RMW is at least 30% lower, with no increase in off-chip spill, descriptor+weight traffic, or dense commit. Destination groups must be <=1.05x A1-OSG. All exactness checks must be zero mismatch.
one_day_cpu_successor_gate.stop_if: Any free psum removal, weaker spilling A1, Acc16-only fit, hidden second channel pass, uncharged 1RW/commit/overlap tax, group inflation above 1.05x, D3 speedup below 1.20 without the traffic alternative, or any mismatch.
one_day_cpu_successor_gate.post_go_boundary: GO would authorize only a fresh independent CPU result hammer. RTL/VCS/EDA and paper speedup remain false until separately authorized.
one_day_cpu_successor_gate.present_decision: STOP: sealed M722r2/M732 already fails both cycle and real-traffic gates.
